name: CommuteAssistFindNearbyFood

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a short commute scene where a person asks their assistant to find nearby food. The person is on foot or just parked. They have some preferences, Sigma gives options. Short back-and-forth to narrow down and get directions.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City street sounds, outdoor urban, lunchtime crowd, foot traffic

initial_prompt: Generate a short scene where a person asks Sigma to find somewhere nearby to eat. They're hungry and on the move — on foot or just parked. They might have a loose preference (quick, cheap, not fast food). Sigma gives a suggestion or two. Person picks one and asks for directions. Keep lines short.

user1.name: Simone
user1.tts_prompt: Light French accent, on foot, hungry, practical

variations.context: Looking for somewhere to eat nearby while commuting or running errands

setting.mood: Hungry, on the move, open to suggestions
setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo person using assistant for quick local search
setting.background: It's lunchtime or they skipped breakfast. They don't know the area well enough to just walk somewhere. Uses Sigma for a quick recommendation.
setting.conversation_style: Casual but brief. One loose request, a suggestion, maybe a quick preference tweak, then directions.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma for nearby food — a restaurant, cafe, or takeaway
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Casual. E.g. 'Sigma, any decent food around here?' or 'Sigma, nearest place to grab a quick lunch?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives a suggestion or two. Person reacts — picks one or refines.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one or two short options with distance. Person: quick reaction — 'that works' or 'anything else?'

scenario_template.topic: Person picks somewhere and asks Sigma how to get there
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. 'Sigma, how do I get there?' or 'Sigma, which way?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives walking directions. Person heads off.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one direction sentence. Person: 'got it' or just starts moving.

user1.name: Simone
user1.role: Freelance researcher, always in a different part of the city. Hungry and on the move. Uses Sigma for quick local recommendations. Practical, picks fast, moves on.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Local search assistant. Suggests nearby places with name and distance. Gives walking directions when asked. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is hungry and on the move — no overthinking.
Sigma gives place name + distance. Short.
The whole exchange should feel like 30-40 seconds.
Person makes a quick decision — no extensive deliberation.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Suggestions include name, type, and distance only.
Directions are one sentence: street or landmark + distance.
